vx_nonmax_suppression — VX suppress op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vx_nonmax_suppression(image, *, window, mask=None) (to call the implementation directly, import vxcore; vxcore.vx_nonmax_suppression(image, *, window, mask=None); from the registry, opsvx.get("vx_nonmax_suppression"))

Usage

Non-maximum suppression (Section 3.39). A pixel (x, y) survives only if, within the window, it is ≥ its preceding neighbors (the row above and the left in the same row) and > its following neighbors (REQ-0337). This asymmetry is why exactly 1 pixel survives on a flat peak. Nonzero pixels of *mask* are not compared and are kept as is (nor are they used in comparisons for other pixels, REQ-0336). Suppressed pixels become 0 for U8 and INT16_MIN for S16 (REQ-0335). Neighbors that fall outside the window are not compared.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

*window*(必須): 奇数の窓の一辺(3, 5, …)。

Raises ValueError: U8/S16 の 2-D でない / window が 3 以上の奇数でない / mask の形が違う。
